docs: Invoice 2024-0117 from Northwind Traders. Copper tubing 14 lengths, brass fittings 6, solder 500 g. Total due 176.16 including VAT, payable within 30 days.
Invoice 5531 from Hallam Electrical. Rewiring of kitchen sockets, new consumer unit, testing and certificate. Labour 12 hours. Total 940.00.
Invoice from Greenway Landscaping for hedge trimming, lawn treatment and removal of a fallen birch tree. Amount 385.00, paid by bank transfer.
Tenancy agreement for Flat 4, 12 Harbour Street. The rent is 1,150 per month, due on the first. The deposit of 1,725 is held in a protected scheme. Pets are not allowed without written consent.
Commercial lease of Unit 7, Dockside Industrial Estate, for a term of five years. The tenant is responsible for repairs and business rates. Break clause after year three.
Notice to quit. The landlord requires possession of the property on 30 June. Please return all keys and leave the flat clean and empty.
Employment contract for the post of warehouse supervisor. Salary 31,000 per year, 28 days holiday, three months probation, one month notice on either side.
Letter confirming your promotion to senior analyst from 1 April with a pay rise to 46,500 and an annual bonus of up to ten percent.
Payslip for March. Gross pay 2,583.33, income tax 316.60, national insurance 198.20, pension contribution 129.17, net pay 1,939.36.
Self assessment tax return for the year. Income from self-employment 38,200, allowable expenses 6,410, tax owed 5,912 to be paid by 31 January.
Council tax bill for the year for band D. Annual charge 2,065.40 payable in ten monthly instalments by direct debit.
Home insurance policy schedule. Buildings cover up to 500,000, contents cover 60,000, excess 250. Accidental damage is included. Renewal date 14 September.
Car insurance certificate for a Ford Focus. Comprehensive cover, named drivers two, no claims discount nine years, premium 412.80.
MOT test certificate. Vehicle passed. Advisory: front brake pads wearing thin, nearside rear tyre close to the legal limit. Mileage 68,412.
Service record for the boiler. Annual gas safety check completed, flue tested, pressure adjusted, no faults found. Next service due in twelve months.
Quotation for replacing the boiler in the east wing with a condensing model, including removal of the old unit, new thermostat and five year warranty. Price 3,480.
Minutes of the residents committee. The quarterly accounts were reviewed, the maintenance reserve will rise by four percent, and the boiler replacement was deferred pending a second quotation.
Agenda for the annual general meeting: election of officers, treasurer's report, proposed changes to the constitution, any other business.
Hospital discharge summary. Admitted with chest pain, diagnosed with a minor heart attack, stent fitted. Prescribed aspirin, a statin and a beta blocker. Follow-up in cardiology in six weeks.
Prescription for amoxicillin 500 mg three times daily for seven days for a chest infection. Take with food. Finish the course.
Dental treatment plan: two fillings, a crown on an upper molar and a scale and polish. Estimated cost 780 across three visits.
Eye test results. Slight short-sightedness, right eye minus 1.25, left eye minus 1.00. New glasses recommended for driving. Next test in two years.
Vaccination record for a child: measles, mumps and rubella first dose at twelve months, booster at three years four months, flu spray each autumn.
School report for Year 8. Strong progress in mathematics and science, needs to take more care with written work in history. Attendance 97 percent.
University offer letter. A place on the BSc Mechanical Engineering course, conditional on grades AAB including mathematics and physics.
Certificate of completion: first aid at work, three day course, valid for three years.
Recipe for lentil soup. Fry onion, carrot and celery, add red lentils, cumin and stock, simmer for twenty five minutes and blend. Serves four.
Recipe for sourdough bread. Mix flour, water, salt and starter, fold four times over three hours, prove overnight in the fridge and bake in a hot cast iron pot.
Instruction manual for a washing machine. Load the drum, add detergent to the drawer, choose a programme and press start. Clean the filter every month.
Warranty card for a laptop. Two years parts and labour from the date of purchase. Accidental damage and battery wear are excluded.
Flight booking confirmation. Manchester to Lisbon, departing 07:15 on 3 May, returning 19:40 on 10 May, two adults, one cabin bag each.
Hotel reservation for seven nights in a double room with breakfast. Free cancellation until 48 hours before arrival. City tax payable locally.
Passport renewal application checklist: completed form, two identical photographs, old passport, fee of 88.50.
Last will and testament. I appoint my sister as executor. I leave my house to my children in equal shares and 5,000 to the lifeboat charity.
Power of attorney for property and financial affairs, appointing my daughter to act if I lose mental capacity. Registered with the public guardian.
Mortgage offer. Loan of 212,000 over 25 years at a fixed rate of 4.39 percent for five years. Monthly payment 1,166. Early repayment charges apply.
Bank statement for the joint current account. Opening balance 2,410.18, salary credit, standing orders for rent and utilities, closing balance 1,077.52.
Electricity bill. Usage 412 kWh at 27.1 pence, standing charge 61 pence a day, total 129.94 for the month. Meter reading estimated.
Site plan revision C for the rear extension, scale 1:100, showing the new drainage run, boundary fence and position of the soakaway.
Structural engineer's report. Hairline cracks above the bay window are due to thermal movement and are not a sign of subsidence. No remedial work needed.
Planning permission decision notice. Approved, subject to conditions: matching brickwork, obscured glazing to the side window, work to start within three years.
User guide for the accounts software: how to raise a credit note, reconcile the bank feed and export the VAT return.
